evidence: Board search DOES filter when used via the on-page Keyword box (unlike the ?k= URL param): 'software engineer' -> 137 results (was 514 unfiltered), 'graduate program 2027' -> 307. Only US SWE-adjacent hit is 'Software Engineer AI' (Ridgefield, CT, Job ID 33178), still live/Apply Now, states 'unable to sponsor... must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship currently and in the future' (no_sponsorship), but the posting states no explicit years-of-experience or grad-year requirement, so it's not clearly a 0-1yr new-grad role. 'Graduate program 2027' search surfaced only Co-Ops and Summer Interns (Co-Op IT Engineer, Design Intern, etc.), no full-time new-grad SWE track.
